about: #139: the riddle of the evening at grade 1: Bà says the riddle and how to answer it; the child finds a chicken and taps it.
allow: is under the bottom of the screen

walk.thingExpr: (() => { const s = tre.activeVillage.state(); const h = s.entities.find((e) => e.id === 'hero').position; return s.entities.filter((e) => e.kind === 'chicken' && e.position && !e.hidden).sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.position.x - h.x, a.position.z - h.z) - Math.hypot(b.position.x - h.x, b.position.z - h.z))[0]?.id ?? null; })()

tap.thingExpr: (() => { const s = tre.activeVillage.state(); const h = s.entities.find((e) => e.id === 'hero').position; return s.entities.filter((e) => e.kind === 'chicken' && e.position && !e.hidden).sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.position.x - h.x, a.position.z - h.z) - Math.hypot(b.position.x - h.x, b.position.z - h.z))[0]?.id ?? null; })()
